snippet.title: Blood Reaver - Playtest Announcment Trailer
snippet.description:
Blood Reaver is a Dark-fantasy, Round-based FPS. Become the Blood Reaver in solo or 4-player co-op. Harness forbidden magic and weaponry to shoot, blast and slice your way through endless hordes of demons. Upgrade your arsenal and survive long enough to discover the ancient secrets of the gods of hell.

Coming to early access 2026!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2906070/Blood_Reaver/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=blood_reaver_earlyaccess

Follow us here:  https://linktr.ee/hellbytestudios

Developed By: Hell Byte Studios
Published By: CULT Games
